ACH001.name: First Breath
ACH001.description: Release your first species into the world.
ACH001.flavor: Every living world begins with one small act of creation.

ACH002.name: Chain of Life
ACH002.description: Build a complete 4-level food chain simultaneously.
ACH002.flavor: Grass to herbivore to predator to apex — the circle is complete.

ACH003.name: First Evolution
ACH003.description: Observe a natural mutation event in your ecosystem.
ACH003.flavor: Life does not ask permission before it changes.

ACH004.name: Adaptation
ACH004.description: A species adapts a new trait under environmental pressure.
ACH004.flavor: Pressure creates diamonds — and new species.

ACH005.name: The Branching
ACH005.flavor: One becomes two. The tree of life grows another branch.

ACH006.name: Requiem
ACH006.flavor: Extinction is not failure. It is selection.

ACH007.name: Survival Master
ACH007.flavor: One hundred generations. The definition of resilience.

ACH009.name: Apex Creator
ACH009.description: Create and sustain an Apex Predator with population above 20.
ACH009.flavor: At the top of the chain, nothing hunts you.

ACH010.name: Master Geneticist
ACH010.description: Fully unlock all Gene Lab capabilities.
ACH010.flavor: The genome holds no more secrets from you.

ACH011.name: Against All Odds
ACH011.description: A species survives a volcanic eruption.
ACH011.flavor: When the mountain exploded, one lineage refused to die.

ACH012.name: Planet Builder
ACH012.description: Fill all 8 biomes with at least one living species.
ACH012.flavor: Forest, grassland, mountain, river, lake, desert, swamp, arctic — all alive.

ACH013.name: Ecosystem Architect
ACH013.description: Maintain biodiversity index above 0.7 for 500 ticks.
ACH013.flavor: Balance is not luck. Balance is design.

ACH014.name: Research Pioneer
ACH014.description: Unlock every node in the research tree.
ACH014.flavor: There is nothing left to discover. Now it is time to create.

ACH015.name: Genesis
ACH015.description: Create a self-sustaining ecosystem with no intervention for 200 ticks.
ACH015.flavor: You built it. Then you let it go. It survived anyway.

ACH016.name: Comeback Story
ACH016.description: A species recovers from 3 or fewer individuals back to 50+.
ACH016.flavor: Three individuals. The spark that refused to go out.

ACH017.name: Pandemonium
ACH017.description: Trigger 5 different disaster types in a single session.
ACH017.flavor: Chaos is also a tool. A blunt one, but effective.

ACH018.name: Perfect Biome
ACH018.description: A single biome reaches 100% ecological health score.
ACH018.flavor: A perfect biome is a symphony with no wrong notes.

ACH019.name: Ancient Lineage
ACH019.description: A species survives for 500 or more generations.
ACH019.flavor: Five hundred generations. They were here before. They will be here after.

ACH020.name: Living Planet
ACH020.description: Reach 50 simultaneous species across the world.
ACH020.flavor: Fifty voices in the chorus of life.

ACH021.name: The Ice Architect
ACH021.description: Trigger an Ice Age and have 3 species survive.
ACH021.flavor: The ice is indiscriminate. The strong adapt.

ACH022.name: Pack Lord
ACH022.description: A pack-hunting species with Intelligence 8+ reaches population 100.

ACH023.name: Synthetic Dawn
ACH023.description: Create a fully synthetic organism reaching 30 individuals.
ACH023.flavor: Not born. Designed. And yet, alive.

ACH024.name: Trophic Cascade
ACH024.description: Remove the apex predator and observe a full trophic cascade.
ACH024.flavor: Remove the top, and the whole tower shakes.

ACH025.name: Time Lord
ACH025.description: Simulate 10,000 world ticks in a single session.
ACH025.flavor: Ten thousand moments. Each one a generations worth of decisions.
